[SWS_CM_10285] Responsibility of proper string encoding
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211, RS_-
AP_00136
⌈
The application provides the string always in the UTF-8 encoding. The SOME/IP
binding has to re-encode the data to the on-the-wire encoding that is configured
by
ApSomeipTransformationProps
.
stringEncoding
. If
ApSomeipTransfor-
mationProps
.
stringEncoding
is not configured explicitly, the default value for
STRING_ENCODING
defined in [PRS_SOMEIP_00372] shall be used.
⌋
